### [AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents](https://huggingface.co/blog/ServiceNow-AI/autosynthdata)

**Hugging Face** · 2026-10-02

AutoSynthData is a framework developed by ServiceNow AI to generate synthetic, structured training datasets specifically designed for fine-tuning enterprise AI agents.

- Generates realistic, task-oriented synthetic conversation and workflow data to train specialized enterprise agents.
- Addresses privacy constraints and domain-specific data scarcity inherent in enterprise automation tasks.

**Why it matters:** It enables organizations to train high-performing, domain-specific AI agents without exposing sensitive customer enterprise data or relying on scarce human-annotated logs.
